services.title: UX/UI & digital

faq_title: Good to know before we talk

faq.q: Can we work with just one of you?
faq.a: Of course. Identity-only and digital-only projects have one lead designer, and the other still reviews the work at no extra cost. Either way, you get a second pair of eyes.

faq.q: Do you work with clients outside Canada?
faq.a: Yes, happily. We're based in the Greater Toronto Area and already work with businesses in India and beyond, remotely or in person.
Simply. You get a fixed quote, split into a deposit to get started and payments at milestones we agree on together.

faq.q: What do you need from us to start?
faq.a: A 20-minute call, any brand files you already have, and one person on your side who can make decisions. That's all.
